The '''Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle (ULAV)''' was a tiny [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] first used in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]' Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle was a compact, fast, and agile [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] assault vehicle.<ref name="RASB" /> Measuring seven [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the ULAV was crewed by two: a driver and a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="RASB2" /> New ULAVs cost between 20,000<ref name="AEG" /> and 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]];<ref name="RECG" /> used ULAVs traded for between 12,900<ref name="RASB2" /> and 22,000 credits.<ref name="RECG" />

Despite being a small craft, the ULAV mounted an impressive weapons array. Forward-mounted weapons were controlled by the driver, and included<ref name="RASB" /> twin [[Mk 2/S laser cannon]]<ref name="MBC" /> or double light [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]],<ref name="AEG" /> and a [[Concussion grenade launcher/Legends|concussion grenade launcher]]<ref name="RASB" /> with a magazine of six [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]<ref name="AEG" /> or a [[Mk 1/S concussion missile launcher]] with a magazine of three [[Mk 1/S concussion missile]]s.<ref name="MBC" /> The gunner controlled the rear-mounted weapon, which was usually either<ref name="RASB" /> a [[Mk 3e/S medium blaster cannon]]<ref name="MBC" /> or heavy blaster cannon.<ref name="RECG" /> The rear-mounted weapon was the ULAV's biggest design flaw. Although it had a firing arc of one-hundred and eighty degrees, it could not fire in front of the ULAV, requiring the driver to maneuver the ULAV into an optimum firing position by slewing the craft around. With the rear of the craft facing the enemy, the gunner was able to fire several shots before the driver had to move the craft out of the way of return fire.<ref name="RASB" />

The ULAV could reach speeds of four hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]],<ref name="RASB2" /> but had inefficient [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] resulting in a ground clearance of only 0.6 meters, which could cause problems when the vehicle traveled through underbrush or rocky outcroppings.<ref name="RASB" /> It had a cargo capacity of between five<ref name="RASB2" /> and twenty-five [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], and a [[Standard week/Legends|week's]] worth of consumables.<ref name="RECG" />

When the ULAV entered service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Alliance technicians only had to perform minor modifications to make them effective combatants, including increasing the power flow and adding [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielding]].<ref name="RASB" />

==History==
[[File:ULAV-RECG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A rebel trooper gives orders in front of a ULAV]]
Ultra-Light Assault Vehicles were developed by Sienar and employed as rapid assault craft ideally deployed from [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] and large [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] utilized ULAVs, which were effective against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Droid/Legends|droids]] formations, breaking through their lines where they were able to employ their forward and rear-mounted weapons in target-rich environments. With the transition of the Republic to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ULAVs were deployed extensively in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until they were phased out in favor of larger, more powerful ground vehicles with primary forward-facing weapons,<ref name="RECG" /> such as [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="AEG" />

The decommissioned vehicles could not be sold: the craft was too small and underpowered to be used by image-conscious commercial concerns, planetary defense forces,<ref name="RASB" /> or police forces, and the cargo capacity was too limited to appeal to criminals or [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="AEG" /> The ULAV fleet was forgotten and stored in warehouses across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with other heavy equipment. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hiffis]], a commando raid netted a huge fleet of ULAVs along with other equipment. The Alliance classified them as [[Combat Assault Vehicle]]s, and they were the smallest and quickest craft in the Alliance ground fleet.<ref name="RASB" />

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], four ULAVs were assigned to the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' during its mission to track down [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]].<ref name="TDC" />
